topic: Alibaba Qwen 5 and Zhenwu V900 roadmap

content.text: Alibaba just put a striking number on its next AI frontier: Qwen 5 is planned at 5–10 trillion parameters, while its new Zhenwu V900 chip is slated for mass production in early 2027. Bigger models are easy to market; the harder question is whether Alibaba's own silicon can make that scale practical. Which matters more now: model size or compute efficiency?
